music.prompt: Nu-jazz broken beat at exactly 124 BPM for a product comparison motion graphics film: warm Rhodes electric piano, a walking upright bass, brushed jazz hi-hats and a broken-beat kick; soulful and modern. No vocals. It starts immediately (0 to 9.5 seconds) with Rhodes chords, walking bass and brushes, murky and dim like something sinking; a low swell rises from 9.5 seconds and stops for one beat at 11.4 seconds; at 11.6 seconds the full band drops in with a bright horn stab and a four-on-the-floor kick, bright and uplifting, Rhodes and horns trading riffs, getting fuller at 23 seconds and carrying at full energy all the way to the end. It ends cleanly on a downbeat at 40 seconds with no big final hit, no breakdown and no fade.
